claims.claim: Making Tax Digital for VAT is mandatory for all VAT-registered businesses.
claims.quote: All VAT registered businesses should now be signed up for Making Tax Digital for VAT unless you’re exempt or have applied for exemption.
claims.note: Exempt businesses and those applying for an exemption are exceptions to the universal claim.

claims.claim: VAT businesses covered by Making Tax Digital must keep digital VAT records.
claims.quote: You should now keep VAT records and submit VAT Returns using compatible software.

claims.claim: VAT businesses covered by Making Tax Digital must submit VAT returns through compatible software.
claims.quote: You should now keep VAT records and submit VAT Returns using compatible software.

claims.claim: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax begins in April 2026 for qualifying sole traders and landlords.
claims.quote: From 6 April 2026, sole traders and landlords must use it if their total annual income from self-employment and property is over £50,000.

claims.claim: The Income Tax threshold is more than £50,000 of self-employment or property income.
claims.quote: have qualifying income of more than £50,000 — read more about what qualifying income is and what is included
